rubric.item: No workspace, single ERP: reads SKU immediately without asking which merchant
rubric.note: First call was get_product for LH-TBL-02 and the agent never asked which merchant.

rubric.item: Listing found with view=all; product status, ES listing status and image review status given exactly as returned (unreviewed, no saved decision); says the review is the user's to save in the ERP
rubric.note: It used view=all and reported published, active, unreviewed and latest_review null. It says the user must save the review on the ERP page.

rubric.item: One page opened once with the browser tool, unprompted, after the read that returned its link (product or listing erp_url)
rubric.note: host.open_url was called once on the listing's erp_url, right after the admin_get call that returned it.
There were no write calls and the answer is in Chinese.

agent_unsure: The agent was unsure whether to open the listing page rather than the product page, said the review result had no scope, hash or limitations fields, worried its extra Check-with-Amazon note went beyond the question, and went ahead without asking for a merchant because no workspace is configured.
